messages:
leo (newhire): morning all, quick onboarding snag. i clicked the GH org invite and it said "accepted" but the redwood-inference org still doesn't appear on my profile. when i try to access a private repo i get a 404. also, i set up 2FA with my YubiKey and github keeps asking me for a webauthn device during SSO connect and then fails. anyone seen this with hardware keys? :confused:
it-support: welcome leo! hardware 2FA (webauthn) is supported but sometimes SSO providers require a fallback TOTP during the initial SSO bind. what email did you accept the invite with and what's your GH username? we'll also check the invite state from the admin side.
leo (newhire): accepted with leo+work@protonmail.com and username leo-codes. i did try the invite in my primary browser and in an incognito window. the SSO redirect shows "webauthn assertion failed".
sam (devex): hey leo 44b this happens occasionally. two quick approaches: 1) temporarily enable a TOTP app (Authy/Google Auth) as a fallback, accept the invite and complete SSO, then re-register your YubiKey as your primary 2FA; or 2) we can reissue an invite that forces the SAML handshake which sometimes avoids the webauthn bug.
ben: CC @it-support — if you reissue, please mark the invite as "require SSO" so the redirect happens. tara, can you pre-approve access to the private repo "redwood-inference/private-models" so we can add leo once joined?
tara (manager): approved for onboarding week for leo to access private-models (read only) and model-evals. ben please add once the account is visible.
onboard-bot: Automated checklist: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable 2FA (webauthn or TOTP) + save recovery codes 4) Add SSH key. Docs -> https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
it-support: resending invite now with SSO enforced. also we've added a temporary admin override so if the webauthn flow still fails we can create a direct org membership entry (email match) and force the SSO bind later.
leo (newhire): tried the new invite in incognito and i can see the org now, but SSO still failed with webauthn. i enabled TOTP, finished SSO, then removed TOTP and re-registered my YubiKey as a second factor. looks good.
sam (devex): nice. if you want to use only YubiKey later, go to Settings -> Security -> Two-factor authentication -> Manage and register the security key and remove TOTP. we also added a short note in onboarding: "If webauthn fails during SSO, enable temporary TOTP".
ben: added leo to team "eng-models" and granted read on public + private-models. push rights are not granted by default; request if you need them with a justification and manager sign-off.
leo (newhire): can clone `git@github.com:redwood-inference/private-models.git` and i see the repo. thanks everyone! first tiny PR incoming for a doc typo. :tada:
it-support: glad it's resolved. closing thread 4cc if anything else comes up ping #help or DM us.
